{{Top|leg}}
A '''flexisteel lanyard''' was a strengthened cable employed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in tandem with a [[turbo-projected grappling hook]] to capture live [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]].
